entries.title: Psalms 133:1
segments: In all the relations of life, harmony is equally pleasant and promotive of strength and prosperity.  In the household of God, it is the indispensable condition of his presence and blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 133:2
segments: The precious ointment; used at Aaron's consecration as high-priest.

entries.title: Psalms 133:3
segments: Hermon; the high southern part of the range of mountains that runs east of Lebanon and nearly parallel with it.  It lies around the sources of the Jordan.
